import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/test_4.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV into a DataFrame
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype=str)  # Read all columns as string to match target schema
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in correct order
        df = df[['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Optional: Clean data if needed (strip whitespace)
    combined_df = combined_df.applymap(lambda x: x.strip() if isinstance(x, str) else x)

    # Ensure the data types are string as per target schema
    combined_df = combined_df.astype({
        'Year': 'string',
        'Category': 'string',
        'Nominee': 'string',
        'Movie': 'string',
        'Winner': 'string'
    })

    # Save the combined dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_65/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
